title: Mitigating large circuits with a learned small-circuit mitigator
abstract: arXiv:2611.28261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-based quantum error mitigation infers noise-free results from noisy measurement data. However, exact training labels become prohibitively expensive to compute as circuits grow, and the generalization capability of a trained model to infer accurate results on circuits of depths and sizes it was not trained on poses a challenge. We show that circuit cutting allows such a model to be reused on circuits larger than those it was trained on. We benchmark this approach against zero-noise extrapolation, Clifford data regression, and probabilistic error cancellation on simulated circuits several times wider and deeper than the training circuits. On random-circuit chains, the fragment-wise mitigator removes most of the reconstructed error. For a holographic Ising-chain eigensolver under a fixed shot budget, it recovers most of the noise-induced energy error, close to 90\% or more, and outperforms Clifford data regression and probabilist

translated_title: 利用学习到的小电路缓解器缓解大型电路误差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28261v1 公告类型：cross。基于学习的量子误差缓解方法从含噪声的测量数据中推断无噪声的结果。然而，随着电路规模的增长，精确训练标签的计算成本变得极其高昂，且训练好的模型在推断其未曾训练过的深度和规模的电路时，其泛化能力也是一个挑战。我们证明，电路切割技术可以使这样的模型在比其训练电路更大的电路上被重复使用。我们在比训练电路宽数倍、深数倍的模拟电路上，将该方法与零噪声外推、Clifford数据回归和概率误差消除进行基准对比。在随机电路链上，逐片段缓解器消除了大部分重构误差。对于固定测量次数预算下的全息Ising链本征求解器，该方法恢复了大部分由噪声引起的能量误差，接近90%或更高，并优于Clifford数据回归和概率误差消除（方法）。
tldr: 提出利用电路切割技术，使仅在小电路上训练的学习型量子误差缓解模型能够复用于更大更深的电路，恢复约90%以上的噪声引起的能量误差并优于现有主流缓解方法。
en_tdlr: Circuit cutting enables a learned small-circuit error mitigator to be reused on circuits several times wider and deeper than its training circuits, recovering close to 90% or more of the noise-induced energy error and outperforming Clifford data regression and probabilistic error cancellation.
